```tsx
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import type { Node } from "@/api/types";
import { AddOsdDialog } from "@/ceph/AddOsdDialog";
import { resetTasks } from "@/tasks/tasks";
import { DISKS, NODE, task } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { mockLists, renderPage } from "@/test/render";
import { apiUrl, server } from "@/test/server";

afterEach(() => {
  toast.dismiss();
  resetTasks();
});

const NODE_B: Node = { ...NODE, id: "n2", name: "node-b" };

/** 노드마다 디스크 목록을 돌려주고 `POST /ceph/osds`의 본문을 모은다. */
function setup(onClose = vi.fn()) {
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, NODE_B] });
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/nodes/:key/disks"), ({ params }) =>
      HttpResponse.json(params.key === "n1" ? DISKS : [DISKS[1]]),
    ),
    http.post(apiUrl("/ceph/osds"), async ({ request }) => {
      sent.push(await request.json());
      return HttpResponse.json(task("t-osd", "ceph-osd-add", "c1"), { status: 202 });
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<AddOsdDialog onClose={onClose} />);
  return { sent, onClose, user: userEvent.setup() };
}

it("adds an OSD on an empty disk", async () => {
  const { sent, onClose, user } = setup();
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Disks" });
  // 쓰는 중인 디스크는 고를 수 없고 이유를 보인다.
  const sda = within(table).getByText("/dev/sda").closest("tr")!;
  expect(sda).toHaveTextContent("In usesystem disk (/ is on it)");
  expect(within(sda).queryByRole("radio")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(within(table).getByText("/dev/sdb").closest("tr")).toHaveTextContent(
    "/dev/sdbwwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d420 GiBHDDST2000 · Z1X2Available",
  );
  const add = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add OSD" });
  expect(add).toBeDisabled();
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdb" }));
  await user.click(add);
  expect(await screen.findByText("Add a Ceph OSD on node-a /dev/sdb")).toBeInTheDocument();
  // 확인한 디스크는 by-id 경로로 보낸다.
  expect(sent).toEqual([
    { node: "n1", device: "/dev/disk/by-id/wwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d4", wipe: false },
  ]);
  expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
});

it("erases a disk that is not empty only after its name is typed", async () => {
  const { sent, user } = setup();
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdc" }));
  const add = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Erase and add OSD" });
  expect(add).toBeDisabled();
  expect(
    screen.getByText(
      "The disk is not empty: gpt partition table, ext4 filesystem. Everything on it is erased.",
    ),
  ).toBeInTheDocument();
  const confirm = screen.getByLabelText("Type /dev/sdc to erase all data on it");
  await user.type(confirm, "sdb");
  expect(add).toBeDisabled();
  await user.clear(confirm);
  await user.type(confirm, "sdc");
  await user.click(add);
  await waitFor(() => expect(sent).toEqual([{ node: "n1", device: "/dev/sdc", wipe: true }]));
});

it("reads the disks of the chosen node", async () => {
  const { user } = setup();
  await screen.findByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdc" });
  await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("Node"), "node-b");
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(screen.queryByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdc" })).not.toBeInTheDocument(),
  );
  expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdb" })).not.toBeChecked();
});

it("shows why the server refused the disk", async () => {
  const { user } = setup();
  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/ceph/osds"), () =>
      HttpResponse.json(
        { code: "disk_in_use", message: "/dev/sdb cannot hold an OSD: mounted at /srv" },
        { status: 409 },
      ),
    ),
  );
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("radio", { name: "/dev/sdb" }));
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add OSD" }));
  expect(
    await screen.findByText(
      "The disk cannot hold an OSD: /dev/sdb cannot hold an OSD: mounted at /srv",
    ),
  ).toBeInTheDocument();
});
```

`web/src/ceph/AddOsdDialog.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { NodeDisk } from "@/api/types";
import { CEPH_KEY, confirmWipe, diskChoice } from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatBytes } from "@/lib/format";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";

/** 노드의 디스크 목록(`GET /nodes/{key}/disks`). 노드에 묻는 것이라 다시 시도하지 않고 오류를 곧바로 보인다. */
export function useNodeDisks(node: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["node-disks", node],
    queryFn: () => call(api.GET("/nodes/{key}/disks", { params: { path: { key: node } } })),
    enabled: node !== "",
    retry: false,
  });
}

/** 디스크 상태의 글: 쓸 수 있음, 지워야 함(이유들), 쓰는 중(이유) */
export function DiskStateText({ disk }: { disk: NodeDisk }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const choice = diskChoice(disk);
  return (
    <>
      <Badge
        variant={
          choice.kind === "available" ? "default" : choice.kind === "wipe" ? "secondary" : "outline"
        }
      >
        {t(`ceph.disk.${choice.kind}`)}
      </Badge>
      {choice.kind !== "available" && (
        <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {choice.kind === "wipe" ? choice.reasons.join(", ") : choice.reason}
        </span>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 디스크 표. `onChoose`가 있으면 쓸 수 있거나 지워야 하는 디스크를 고르는 단추를 둔다(쓰는 중인 디스크는 이유만).
 */
export function DiskTable({
  disks,
  label,
  chosen,
  onChoose,
}: {
  disks: NodeDisk[];
  label: string;
  chosen?: string;
  onChoose?(disk: NodeDisk): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  if (disks.length === 0) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.disk.none")}</p>;
  }
  return (
    <Table aria-label={label}>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          {onChoose && (
            <TableHead>
              <span className="sr-only">{t("ceph.disk.choose")}</span>
            </TableHead>
          )}
          <TableHead>{t("ceph.disk.device")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("ceph.disk.size")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("ceph.disk.type")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("ceph.disk.model")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("common.state")}</TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {disks.map((disk) => (
          <TableRow key={disk.path}>
            {onChoose && (
              <TableCell>
                {disk.state !== "in-use" && (
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="ceph-osd-disk"
                    aria-label={disk.path}
                    checked={chosen === disk.path}
                    onChange={() => onChoose(disk)}
                  />
                )}
              </TableCell>
            )}
            <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
              {disk.path}
              {disk.by_id && (
                <span className="block text-muted-foreground">
                  {disk.by_id.replace(/^\/dev\/disk\/by-id\//, "")}
                </span>
              )}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap">{formatBytes(disk.size_bytes)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>{disk.rotational ? "HDD" : "SSD"}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>{[disk.model, disk.serial].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "—"}</TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              <DiskStateText disk={disk} />
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}

/**
 * 노드의 디스크 하나에 OSD를 만든다(`ceph-osd-add` Task). 비지 않은 디스크는 장치 이름을 다시 쳐야 지우고 쓴다.
 * 열 때만 그린다.
 */
export function AddOsdDialog({
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const choices = (nodes.data ?? []).filter((n) => !n.spec.witness && n.status.online);
  const [node, setNode] = useState("");
  const chosenNode = node || (choices[0]?.id ?? "");
  const disks = useNodeDisks(chosenNode);
  const [path, setPath] = useState("");
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  const disk = disks.data?.find((d) => d.path === path);
  const wipe = disk?.state === "wipeable";
  const ready = disk !== undefined && (!wipe || confirmWipe(disk, typed));

  async function submit() {
    const target = choices.find((n) => n.id === chosenNode);
    if (!target || !disk) {
      return false;
    }
    // 확인한 디스크를 by-id 경로로 보낸다(그사이 장치 이름이 바뀌어도 같은 디스크).
    const device = disk.by_id ?? disk.path;
    const task = await call(api.POST("/ceph/osds", { body: { node: target.id, device, wipe } }));
    trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.ceph-osd-add", { node: target.name, device: disk.path }));
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: CEPH_KEY });
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={t("ceph.osd.addTitle")}
      description={t("ceph.osd.addDescription")}
      submitLabel={t(wipe ? "ceph.osd.wipeAndAdd" : "ceph.osd.add")}
      destructive={wipe}
      submitDisabled={!ready}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      {choices.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.noNodes")}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Field id="ceph-osd-node" label={t("common.node")}>
            <NativeSelect
              id="ceph-osd-node"
              value={chosenNode}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setNode(e.target.value);
                setPath("");
                setTyped("");
              }}
            >
              {choices.map((n) => (
                <NativeSelectOption key={n.id} value={n.id}>
                  {n.name}
                </NativeSelectOption>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </Field>
          <div className="max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto">
            {disks.data ? (
              <DiskTable
                disks={disks.data}
                label={t("ceph.disk.table")}
                chosen={path}
                onChoose={(d) => {
                  setPath(d.path);
                  setTyped("");
                }}
              />
            ) : (
              <ListPending error={disks.error} />
            )}
          </div>
          {disk && wipe && (
            <Field
              id="ceph-osd-confirm"
              label={t("ceph.osd.typeDevice", { device: disk.path })}
              hint={t("ceph.osd.wipeWarning", { reasons: diskReasons(disk) })}
            >
              {(a11y) => (
                <Input
                  id="ceph-osd-confirm"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  value={typed}
                  onChange={(e) => setTyped(e.target.value)}
                  {...a11y}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </FormDialog>
  );
}

function diskReasons(disk: NodeDisk): string {
  return disk.state === "wipeable" ? disk.reasons.join(", ") : "";
}
```

`web/src/ceph/CephPage.test.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import type { CephStatusView, CephView, Node, Principal, Task } from "@/api/types";
import { CephPage } from "@/ceph/CephPage";
import { resetTasks } from "@/tasks/tasks";
import { CEPH, CEPH_STATUS, NET_NODE, NODE, task } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { ADMIN, mockLists, renderPage } from "@/test/render";
import { apiUrl, server } from "@/test/server";

afterEach(() => {
  toast.dismiss();
  resetTasks();
});

const VIEWER: Principal = { ...ADMIN, name: "view", role: "viewer" };

const NODE_B: Node = {
  ...NODE,
  id: "n2",
  name: "node-b",
  status: { ...NODE.status, online: false },
};
const NODE_D: Node = { ...NODE, id: "n4", name: "node-d" };
const WITNESS: Node = { ...NODE, id: "n5", name: "quorum", spec: { ...NODE.spec, witness: true } };

/** `GET /ceph`와 `GET /ceph/status`의 답 */
function ceph(view: CephView, status: CephStatusView | Response = CEPH_STATUS) {
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/ceph"), () => HttpResponse.json(view)),
    http.get(apiUrl("/ceph/status"), () =>
      status instanceof Response ? status : HttpResponse.json(status),
    ),
  );
}

/** 부트스트랩 Task(노드 n1) */
function initTask(state: Task["status"]["state"], extra: Partial<Task["status"]> = {}): Task {
  const t = task("t-init", "ceph-init", "c1");
  return { ...t, status: { ...t.status, state, ...extra } };
}

/** `POST /ceph`에 보낸 본문을 모은다. */
function acceptInit() {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/ceph"), async ({ request }) => {
      sent.push(await request.json());
      return HttpResponse.json(task("t-init", "ceph-init", "c1"), { status: 202 });
    }),
  );
  return sent;
}

it("sets up Ceph from the wizard and follows the bootstrap task", async () => {

  expect(options[1]).toBeDisabled();
  // 노드 주소의 인터페이스 망으로 미리 채운다.

it("goes through the monitor, OSD, pool and client steps", async () => {

  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/ceph"), () => {
      created = true;
      return HttpResponse.json(task("t-init", "ceph-init", "c1"), { status: 202 });
    }),
    http.get(apiUrl("/ceph"), () =>
      created
        ? HttpResponse.json({ ...CEPH, mons: [CEPH.mons[0]], mgrs: ["n1"], osd_nodes: [] })
        : HttpResponse.json({ code: "not_found", message: "no Ceph" }, { status: 404 }),
    ),

  );
```

`web/src/ceph/CephPage.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { usePrincipal } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { can } from "@/auth/permissions";
import { useCeph } from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { CephStatusView } from "@/ceph/CephStatusView";
import { CephWizard } from "@/ceph/CephWizard";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";

/**
 * Orbivisor가 관리하는 Ceph. 없으면 admin에게 만들기 마법사를, 있으면 상태를 보인다. 마법사로 만들기 시작하면 끝내기
 * 전까지 마법사를 그대로 둔다(만든 뒤에도 mon·OSD·풀 단계가 이어진다).
 */
export function CephPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const me = usePrincipal();
  const ceph = useCeph(true);
  const [inWizard, setInWizard] = useState(false);
  const admin = can(me.role, "write", "ceph");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">{t("nav.ceph")}</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.pageHint")}</p>
      </div>
      {ceph.data === undefined ? (
        <ListPending error={ceph.error} />
      ) : ceph.data === null || inWizard ? (
        admin ? (
          <CephWizard
            ceph={ceph.data}
            onStarted={() => setInWizard(true)}
            onDone={() => setInWizard(false)}
          />
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.none")}</p>
        )
      ) : (
        <CephStatusView ceph={ceph.data} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`web/src/ceph/CephStatusView.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Fragment, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Link } from "react-router";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { CephStatusView as Status, CephView } from "@/api/types";
import { usePrincipal } from "@/auth/AuthProvider";
import { can } from "@/auth/permissions";
import { AddMonDialog } from "@/ceph/AddMonDialog";
import { AddOsdDialog } from "@/ceph/AddOsdDialog";
import {
  CEPH_KEY,
  healthTone,
  osdHosts,
  percentOf,
  pgSummary,
  useCephStatus,
  type HealthTone,
} from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { CreateCephPoolDialog } from "@/ceph/CreateCephPoolDialog";
import { InstallClientsDialog } from "@/ceph/InstallClientsDialog";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { errorMessage } from "@/i18n/errors";
import { formatBytes, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";

const TONE_BADGE = {
  ok: "default",
  warn: "secondary",
  err: "destructive",
  unknown: "outline",
} as const satisfies Record<HealthTone, string>;

type Dialog = "mon" | "mgr" | "osd" | "pool" | "clients";

/** 관리 Ceph의 상태: 설정, health, mon·mgr, 호스트별 OSD, PG, 사용량, 풀, admin 동작 */
export function CephStatusView({ ceph }: { ceph: CephView }) {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const me = usePrincipal();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const status = useCephStatus(ceph.mons.length > 0);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Dialog | null>(null);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const admin = can(me.role, "write", "ceph");
  const ready = ceph.phase === "ready";
  const nodeName = (id: string) => nodes.data?.find((n) => n.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const report = status.data;
  const tasks = useList("task");
  // mon이 서기 전에 부트스트랩 노드가 꺼졌거나 빠졌으면 다른 노드로 옮겨 다시 할 수 있다(그 노드의 Task는 버려진다).
  const initNode = nodes.data?.find((n) => n.id === ceph.init_node);
  const initOffline =
    !ready &&
    ceph.mons.length === 0 &&
    nodes.data !== undefined &&
    (initNode === undefined || !initNode.status.online);
  const busy = ceph.tasks.some(
    (id) => !(initOffline && tasks.data?.find((x) => x.id === id)?.spec.node === ceph.init_node),
  );
  const movable = (nodes.data ?? []).filter((n) => !n.spec.witness && n.status.online);
  const [moveTo, setMoveTo] = useState("");
  const retryNode = initOffline
    ? (movable.find((n) => n.id === moveTo) ?? movable[0])?.id
    : ceph.init_node;

  async function retry() {
    const node = retryNode;
    if (!node) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const task = await call(api.POST("/ceph", { body: { node } }));
      trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.ceph-init", { node: nodeName(node) }));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(errorMessage(t, err));
    } finally {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: CEPH_KEY });
    }
  }

  const action = (dialog: Dialog, label: string, disabled = !ready) => (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={(e) => {
        trigger.current = e.currentTarget;
        setOpen(dialog);
      }}
    >
      {label}
    </Button>
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <dl className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Item label={t("ceph.phase")}>{t(`ceph.phases.${ceph.phase}`)}</Item>
        <Item label={t("ceph.release")}>{ceph.release ?? "—"}</Item>
        <Item label={t("ceph.fsid")}>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs">{ceph.fsid}</span>
        </Item>
        <Item label={t("ceph.publicNetwork")}>{ceph.public_network}</Item>
        <Item label={t("ceph.clusterNetwork")}>{ceph.cluster_network ?? "—"}</Item>
        <Item label={t("ceph.managedConf")}>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs">{ceph.managed_conf}</span>
        </Item>
      </dl>
      {!ready && (
        <div role="alert" className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border p-3 text-sm">
          <p>
            {busy
              ? t("ceph.settingUp", { node: nodeName(ceph.init_node ?? "") })
              : t("ceph.notReady")}
          </p>
          {ceph.last_error && <p className="text-destructive">{ceph.last_error}</p>}
          {admin && !busy && ceph.init_node && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {initOffline && (
                <>
                  <label htmlFor="ceph-retry-node">
                    {t("ceph.retryElsewhere", { node: nodeName(ceph.init_node) })}
                  </label>
                  <NativeSelect
                    id="ceph-retry-node"
                    value={retryNode ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) => setMoveTo(e.target.value)}
                  >
                    {movable.map((n) => (
                      <NativeSelectOption key={n.id} value={n.id}>
                        {n.name}
                      </NativeSelectOption>
                    ))}
                  </NativeSelect>
                </>
              )}
              <Button variant="outline" disabled={!retryNode} onClick={() => void retry()}>
                {t("ceph.retry")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {admin && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {action("mon", t("ceph.mon.add"))}
          {action("mgr", t("ceph.mgr.add"))}
          {action("osd", t("ceph.osd.add"))}
          {action("pool", t("ceph.pool.create"))}
          {action("clients", t("ceph.clients.install"), false)}
        </div>
      )}
      {report?.stale && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-md border border-amber-500 p-3 text-sm">
          {t("ceph.stale", {
            time: formatTime(new Date(report.read_at * 1000), i18n.language),
            error: report.error ?? "",
          })}
        </p>
      )}
      {!report ? (
        ceph.mons.length > 0 && <ListPending error={status.error} />
      ) : (
        <Report report={report} />
      )}
      {open === "mon" || open === "mgr" ? (
        <AddMonDialog ceph={ceph} role={open} returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} />
      ) : open === "osd" ? (
        <AddOsdDialog returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} />
      ) : open === "pool" ? (
        <CreateCephPoolDialog
          hosts={report && !report.stale ? report.osd_hosts_up : undefined}
          returnFocus={trigger}
          onClose={() => setOpen(null)}
        />
      ) : open === "clients" ? (
        <InstallClientsDialog ceph={ceph} returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Item({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-sm">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** 사용률 막대 */
function Meter({ label, percent }: { label: string; percent: number }) {
  return (
    <div
      role="meter"
      aria-label={label}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-valuenow={percent}
      className="h-2 w-32 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted"
    >
      <div
        className={percent > 85 ? "h-full bg-destructive" : "h-full bg-primary"}
        style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, percent)}%` }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function Report({ report }: { report: Status }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const tone = healthTone(report.health.status);
  const hosts = osdHosts(report);
  const pgs = pgSummary(report.pgs);
  const usage = report.usage;
  const up = report.osds.filter((o) => o.up).length;
  const inside = report.osds.filter((o) => o.in).length;
  return (
    <>
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
          {t("ceph.health")}
          <Badge variant={TONE_BADGE[tone]}>{report.health.status || t("ceph.unknown")}</Badge>
        </h2>
        {report.health.checks.length > 0 && (
          <ul aria-label={t("ceph.checks")} className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            {report.health.checks.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.code} className={c.muted ? "text-muted-foreground" : undefined}>
                <Badge variant={c.severity === "HEALTH_ERR" ? "destructive" : "secondary"}>
                  {c.severity === "HEALTH_ERR" ? "ERR" : "WRN"}
                </Badge>{" "}
                <span className="font-mono text-xs">{c.code}</span> {c.summary}
                {c.muted && ` (${t("ceph.muted")})`}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h2 id="ceph-mons" className="font-medium">
            {t("ceph.monitors", { n: report.mons.length, quorum: report.quorum.length })}
          </h2>
          <Table aria-labelledby="ceph-mons">
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>{t("common.name")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("ceph.address")}</TableHead>
                <TableHead>{t("ceph.quorum")}</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {report.mons.map((m) => (
                <TableRow key={m.name}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">{m.name}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{m.addr}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Badge variant={m.in_quorum ? "outline" : "destructive"}>
                      {t(m.in_quorum ? "ceph.inQuorum" : "ceph.outOfQuorum")}
                    </Badge>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h2 className="font-medium">{t("ceph.managers")}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm">
            {report.mgr.active
              ? t("ceph.mgrActive", { name: report.mgr.active })
              : t("ceph.mgrNone")}
            {report.mgr.standbys.length > 0 &&
              ` · ${t("ceph.mgrStandbys", { names: report.mgr.standbys.join(", ") })}`}
          </p>
          <h2 className="font-medium">{t("ceph.usage")}</h2>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <Meter
              label={t("ceph.usage")}
              percent={percentOf(usage.used_bytes, usage.total_bytes)}
            />
            {t("ceph.usageText", {
              used: formatBytes(usage.used_bytes),
              available: formatBytes(usage.available_bytes),
              total: formatBytes(usage.total_bytes),
            })}
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-medium">{t("ceph.pgs", { n: report.pgs.total })}</h2>
          {pgs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">—</p>
          ) : (
            <ul aria-label={t("ceph.pgStates")} className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
              {pgs.map((p) => (
                <li key={p.state} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Meter label={p.state} percent={Math.round(p.percent * 10) / 10} />
                  <span className={p.clean ? undefined : "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400"}>
                    {`${p.count} ${p.state}`}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 id="ceph-osds" className="font-medium">
          {t("ceph.osds", { up, in: inside, total: report.osds.length, hosts: hosts.length })}
        </h2>
        <Table aria-labelledby="ceph-osds">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.osdId")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.disk.device")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.class")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("common.state")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.used")}</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {hosts.length === 0 && (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={5} className="text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("ceph.noOsds")}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            )}
            {hosts.map((h) => (
              <Fragment key={h.host}>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={5} className="bg-muted/50 font-medium">
                    {t("ceph.host", { host: h.host, up: h.up, total: h.osds.length })}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
                {h.osds.map((o) => (
                  <TableRow key={o.id}>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{`osd.${o.id}`}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{o.device ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>{o.class ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex gap-1">
                        <Badge variant={o.up ? "outline" : "destructive"}>
                          {t(o.up ? "ceph.up" : "ceph.down")}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant={o.in ? "outline" : "secondary"}>
                          {t(o.in ? "ceph.in" : "ceph.out")}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {o.total_bytes > 0
                        ? `${formatBytes(o.used_bytes)} / ${formatBytes(o.total_bytes)}`
                        : "—"}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </Fragment>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </section>
      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h2 id="ceph-pools" className="font-medium">
          {t("ceph.pools")}
        </h2>
        <Table aria-labelledby="ceph-pools">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.pool.cephPool")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.pool.storagePool")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.pool.size")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.pool.stored")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("ceph.pool.available")}</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {report.pools.map((p) => (
              <TableRow key={p.id}>
                <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{p.name}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {p.orbivisor_pool ? (
                    <Link to="/storage-pools" className="underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
                      {p.orbivisor_pool}
                    </Link>
                  ) : (
                    "—"
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{p.size ?? "—"}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  {`${formatBytes(p.stored_bytes)} (${(p.percent_used * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{formatBytes(p.max_available_bytes)}</TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </section>
    </>
  );
}
```

`web/src/ceph/CephWizard.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { CephView, Node } from "@/api/types";
import { AddMonDialog } from "@/ceph/AddMonDialog";
import { AddOsdDialog } from "@/ceph/AddOsdDialog";
import { CEPH_KEY, INIT_STAGES, monWarning, publicNetworkFor, useCephStatus } from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { CreateCephPoolDialog } from "@/ceph/CreateCephPoolDialog";
import { InstallClientsDialog } from "@/ceph/InstallClientsDialog";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import { errorMessage } from "@/i18n/errors";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";

/** 마법사의 단계: 노드·네트워크, 만들기 진행, mon, OSD, 풀, 클라이언트 꾸러미 */
const STEPS = ["network", "progress", "mons", "osds", "pool", "clients"] as const;
type Step = (typeof STEPS)[number];

/**
 * Ceph 만들기 마법사(admin). 첫 단계가 `POST /ceph`로 만들고, 다음 단계들은 상태 화면의 대화상자를 차례로 연다.
 * mon·OSD·풀·클라이언트 단계는 건너뛸 수 있다. `ceph`는 주기적으로 다시 읽은 관리 Ceph(만들기 전에는 null)다.
 */
export function CephWizard({
  ceph,
  onStarted,
  onDone,
}: {
  ceph: CephView | null;
  onStarted(): void;
  onDone(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("network");
  const [task, setTask] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const next = () => setStep(STEPS[STEPS.indexOf(step) + 1] ?? step);

  return (
    <Card className="max-w-3xl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("ceph.wizard.title")}</CardTitle>
        <ol className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-sm">
          {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
            <li
              key={s}
              aria-current={s === step ? "step" : undefined}
              className={s === step ? "font-medium" : "text-muted-foreground"}
            >
              {`${i + 1}. ${t(`ceph.wizard.steps.${s}`)}`}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {step === "network" ? (
          <NetworkStep
            onCreated={(id) => {
              setTask(id);
              onStarted();
              setStep("progress");
            }}
          />
        ) : step === "progress" ? (
          <ProgressStep task={task} ceph={ceph} onRetried={setTask} onNext={next} />
        ) : ceph ? (
          <ActionStep step={step} ceph={ceph} onNext={step === "clients" ? onDone : next} />
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** ① init 노드와 망. 망은 노드 주소로 미리 채우고, 비워 두면 서버가 같은 규칙으로 정한다. */
function NetworkStep({ onCreated }: { onCreated(task: string): void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const choices = (nodes.data ?? []).filter((n) => !n.spec.witness);
  const [node, setNode] = useState("");
  const chosen: Node | undefined =
    choices.find((n) => n.id === node) ?? choices.find((n) => n.status.online);
  const [publicNetwork, setPublicNetwork] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [clusterNetwork, setClusterNetwork] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const shownPublic = publicNetwork ?? (chosen ? publicNetworkFor(chosen) : "");

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!chosen) {
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const task = await call(
        api.POST("/ceph", {
          body: {
            node: chosen.id,
            ...(shownPublic.trim() !== "" && { public_network: shownPublic.trim() }),
            ...(clusterNetwork.trim() !== "" && { cluster_network: clusterNetwork.trim() }),
          },
        }),
      );
      trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.ceph-init", { node: chosen.name }));
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: CEPH_KEY });
      onCreated(task.id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(t, err));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(e) => void submit(e)} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.wizard.networkHint")}</p>
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <fieldset disabled={busy} className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-4">
        <Field id="ceph-init-node" label={t("ceph.wizard.initNode")}>
          <NativeSelect
            id="ceph-init-node"
            value={chosen?.id ?? ""}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setNode(e.target.value);
              setPublicNetwork(null);
            }}
          >
            {choices.map((n) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={n.id} value={n.id} disabled={!n.status.online}>
                {n.status.online ? n.name : t("ceph.offlineNode", { name: n.name })}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        </Field>
        <Field
          id="ceph-public-network"
          label={t("ceph.publicNetwork")}
          hint={t("ceph.wizard.publicHint")}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="ceph-public-network"
              placeholder="10.0.0.0/24"
              value={shownPublic}
              onChange={(e) => setPublicNetwork(e.target.value)}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
        <Field
          id="ceph-cluster-network"
          label={t("ceph.clusterNetwork")}
          hint={t("ceph.wizard.clusterHint")}
        >
          {(a11y) => (
            <Input
              id="ceph-cluster-network"
              value={clusterNetwork}
              onChange={(e) => setClusterNetwork(e.target.value)}
              {...a11y}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      </fieldset>
      <div>
        <Button type="submit" disabled={busy || !chosen}>
          {t("ceph.wizard.create")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

/** ② 부트스트랩 Task의 진행을 단계 목록으로. 실패하면 이유와 다시 하기(같은 노드로 `POST /ceph`) */
function ProgressStep({
  task: id,
  ceph,
  onRetried,
  onNext,
}: {
  task: string | null;
  ceph: CephView | null;
  onRetried(task: string): void;
  onNext(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const tasks = useList("task");
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const task = tasks.data?.find((x) => x.id === id);
  const done = task?.status.state === "succeeded" || ceph?.phase === "ready";
  const failed = task?.status.state === "failed";
  const stage = task?.status.progress?.stage;
  const current = done ? INIT_STAGES.length : Math.max(0, INIT_STAGES.indexOf(stage as never));

  async function retry() {
    if (!task) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    try {
      const again = await call(api.POST("/ceph", { body: { node: task.spec.node } }));
      const name = nodes.data?.find((n) => n.id === task.spec.node)?.name ?? task.spec.node;
      trackTask(again, t("tasks.op.ceph-init", { node: name }));
      onRetried(again.id);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(errorMessage(t, err));
    } finally {
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: CEPH_KEY });
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <ol aria-label={t("ceph.wizard.stages")} className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
        {INIT_STAGES.map((s, i) => (
          <li
            key={s}
            aria-current={!done && !failed && i === current ? "step" : undefined}
            className={
              i < current
                ? "text-muted-foreground line-through"
                : i === current && !failed
                  ? "font-medium"
                  : undefined
            }
          >
            {t(`tasks.cephStage.${s}`)}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {failed && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {t("ceph.wizard.failed", { error: task.status.error ?? "" })}
        </p>
      )}
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        {failed && (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => void retry()}>
            {t("ceph.retry")}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button disabled={!done} onClick={onNext}>
          {t("ceph.wizard.next")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** ③~⑥ 상태 화면의 대화상자를 여는 단계. 지금 있는 것을 보이고 건너뛸 수 있다. */
function ActionStep({
  step,
  ceph,
  onNext,
}: {
  step: Exclude<Step, "network" | "progress">;
  ceph: CephView;
  onNext(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const status = useCephStatus(step === "pool");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const trigger = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const names = (ids: string[]) =>
    ids.map((id) => nodes.data?.find((n) => n.id === id)?.name ?? id).join(", ") || "—";
  const busy = ceph.tasks.length > 0;
  const warning = step === "mons" ? monWarning(ceph.mons.length) : null;
  const hosts = status.data && !status.data.stale ? status.data.osd_hosts_up : undefined;
  const current = {
    mons: t("ceph.wizard.haveMons", {
      n: ceph.mons.length,
      names: ceph.mons.map((m) => m.name).join(", "),
    }),
    osds: t("ceph.wizard.haveOsds", { names: names(ceph.osd_nodes) }),
    pool: hosts === undefined ? "" : t("ceph.wizard.haveHosts", { n: hosts }),
    clients: "",
  }[step];
  const button = {
    mons: "ceph.mon.add",
    osds: "ceph.osd.add",
    pool: "ceph.pool.create",
    clients: "ceph.clients.install",
  }[step];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t(`ceph.wizard.${step}Hint`)}</p>
      {current && <p className="text-sm">{current}</p>}
      {busy && <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.wizard.busy")}</p>}
      {warning && <p className="text-sm text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">{t(warning)}</p>}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          disabled={busy && step === "mons"}
          onClick={(e) => {
            trigger.current = e.currentTarget;
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          {t(button)}
        </Button>
        <Button onClick={onNext}>
          {t(step === "clients" ? "ceph.wizard.finish" : "ceph.wizard.next")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {open &&
        (step === "mons" ? (
          <AddMonDialog
            ceph={ceph}
            role="mon"
            returnFocus={trigger}
            onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
        ) : step === "osds" ? (
          <AddOsdDialog returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
        ) : step === "pool" ? (
          <CreateCephPoolDialog
            hosts={hosts}
            returnFocus={trigger}
            onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
        ) : (
          <InstallClientsDialog ceph={ceph} returnFocus={trigger} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
        ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`web/src/ceph/CreateCephPoolDialog.test.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { act, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { CreateCephPoolDialog } from "@/ceph/CreateCephPoolDialog";
import { resetTasks } from "@/tasks/tasks";
import { task } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { renderPage } from "@/test/render";
import { apiUrl, server } from "@/test/server";

afterEach(() => {
  toast.dismiss();
  resetTasks();
});

function setup(hosts: number | undefined) {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  server.use(
    http.post(apiUrl("/ceph/pools"), async ({ request }) => {
      sent.push(await request.json());
      return HttpResponse.json(task("t-pool", "ceph-pool-create", "c1"), { status: 202 });
    }),
  );
  renderPage(<CreateCephPoolDialog hosts={hosts} onClose={() => {}} />);
  return { sent, user: userEvent.setup() };
}

it("creates a pool with three copies when three hosts have OSDs", async () => {
  const { sent, user } = setup(4);
  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("3");
  expect(screen.getByText(/4 hosts have OSDs that are up/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Name"), "vms");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  expect(
    await screen.findByText("Create Ceph pool vms as storage pool vms (size 3)"),
  ).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(sent).toEqual([{ name: "vms", size: 3 }]);
});

it("warns about two copies and sends the Ceph pool name", async () => {
  const { sent, user } = setup(2);
  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("2");
  expect(screen.getByText(/Size 2 can lose data/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Name"), "vms");
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Ceph pool"), "rbd-vms");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Create" }));
  await waitFor(() => expect(sent).toEqual([{ name: "vms", size: 2, pool: "rbd-vms" }]));
});

it("asks before keeping a single copy", async () => {
  const { sent, user } = setup(1);
  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("1");
  expect(screen.getByText(/Size 1 keeps a single copy/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Name"), "scratch");
  const create = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Create" });
  expect(create).toBeDisabled();
  await user.click(screen.getByLabelText("I understand that there is no redundancy"));
  await user.click(create);
  await waitFor(() => expect(sent).toEqual([{ name: "scratch", size: 1 }]));
});

it("follows the host count that arrives after opening until a size is chosen", async () => {
  // 상태(호스트 수)가 대화상자를 연 뒤에 온다.
  let arrive: (hosts: number) => void = () => {};
  function Late() {
    const [hosts, setHosts] = useState<number>();
    arrive = setHosts;
    return <CreateCephPoolDialog hosts={hosts} onClose={() => {}} />;
  }
  renderPage(<Late />);
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("3");
  act(() => arrive(1));
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("1");
  await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("Copies (size)"), "2");
  act(() => arrive(3));
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("2");
});

it("checks the names before sending", async () => {

  expect(await screen.findByLabelText("Copies (size)")).toHaveValue("3");
  await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Ceph pool"), "-bad");

  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Name")).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
  expect(screen.getByLabelText("Ceph pool")).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
  expect(sent).toEqual([]);
});
```

`web/src/ceph/CreateCephPoolDialog.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { CEPH_KEY, defaultSize, sizeWarning } from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { Field } from "@/components/Field";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { NativeSelect, NativeSelectOption } from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import { cephNameError } from "@/storage/pools";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";
import { validName } from "@/vms/form";

/**
 * Ceph 풀을 만들어 Orbivisor RBD 풀로 등록한다(`ceph-pool-create` Task). 복제 수의 기본은 min(3, OSD가 up인 호스트
 * 수)이고(상태가 늦게 와도 사용자가 고르지 않았으면 따라간다), 1(사본 하나)은 확인해야 보낸다. `hosts`는 상태를
 * 읽지 못했으면 undefined다. 열 때만 그린다.
 */
export function CreateCephPoolDialog({
  hosts,
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  hosts: number | undefined;
  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [pool, setPool] = useState("");
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<number>();
  const size = chosen ?? defaultSize(hosts ?? 3);
  const [single, setSingle] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<{ name?: string; pool?: string }>({});
  const warning = sizeWarning(size);

  async function submit() {
    const found = {
      name: validName(name) ? undefined : "forms.name",
      pool: pool === "" ? undefined : cephNameError(pool),
    };
    setErrors(found);
    if (found.name || found.pool) {
      return false;
    }
    const task = await call(
      api.POST("/ceph/pools", { body: { name, size, ...(pool !== "" && { pool }) } }),
    );
    trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.ceph-pool-create", { name, pool: pool || name, size }));
    await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: CEPH_KEY });
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={t("ceph.pool.createTitle")}
      description={t("ceph.pool.createDescription")}
      submitLabel={t("common.create")}
      submitDisabled={size === 1 && !single}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      <Field id="ceph-pool-name" label={t("common.name")} error={errors.name}>
        {(a11y) => (
          <Input
            id="ceph-pool-name"
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            {...a11y}
          />
        )}
      </Field>
      <Field
        id="ceph-pool-pool"
        label={t("ceph.pool.cephPool")}
        error={errors.pool}
        hint={t("ceph.pool.cephPoolHint")}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <Input
            id="ceph-pool-pool"
            placeholder={name}
            value={pool}
            onChange={(e) => setPool(e.target.value)}
            {...a11y}
          />
        )}
      </Field>
      <Field
        id="ceph-pool-size"
        label={t("ceph.pool.size")}
        hint={hosts === undefined ? undefined : t("ceph.pool.sizeHint", { hosts })}
      >
        {(a11y) => (
          <NativeSelect
            id="ceph-pool-size"
            value={size}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setChosen(Number(e.target.value));
              setSingle(false);
            }}
            {...a11y}
          >
            {[1, 2, 3].map((n) => (
              <NativeSelectOption key={n} value={n}>
                {n}
              </NativeSelectOption>
            ))}
          </NativeSelect>
        )}
      </Field>
      {warning && <p className="text-sm text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">{t(warning)}</p>}
      {size === 1 && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Checkbox
            id="ceph-pool-single"
            checked={single}
            onCheckedChange={(v) => setSingle(v === true)}
          />
          <Label htmlFor="ceph-pool-single">{t("ceph.pool.singleConfirm")}</Label>
        </div>
      )}
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

`web/src/ceph/InstallClientsDialog.tsx`를 만든다:

```tsx
import { useState, type RefObject } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import { api, call } from "@/api/client";
import { useList } from "@/api/live";
import type { CephView } from "@/api/types";
import { cephRoles } from "@/ceph/ceph";
import { FormDialog } from "@/components/FormDialog";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { trackTask } from "@/tasks/tasks";

/**
 * Ceph 데몬이 없는 노드에 클라이언트 꾸러미(`ceph-common`·`qemu-block-extra`)를 설치한다(노드마다
 * `ceph-client-install` Task). 데몬 노드는 데몬 Task가 이미 설치했다. 위트니스·오프라인 노드는 빼고, 처음에는 모두
 * 고른다. 열 때만 그린다.
 */
export function InstallClientsDialog({
  ceph,
  returnFocus,
  onClose,
}: {
  ceph: CephView;
  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  onClose(): void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const nodes = useList("node");
  const choices = (nodes.data ?? []).filter(
    (n) => !n.spec.witness && n.status.online && cephRoles(ceph, n.id).length === 0,
  );
  const [skipped, setSkipped] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const chosen = choices.filter((n) => !skipped.includes(n.id));

  async function submit() {
    // 하나가 실패하면 거기서 멈추고 그 오류를 보인다(앞의 Task는 이미 시작했다).
    for (const node of chosen) {
      const task = await call(api.POST("/ceph/clients", { body: { node: node.id } }));
      trackTask(task, t("tasks.op.ceph-client-install", { node: node.name }));
      setSkipped((s) => [...s, node.id]);
    }
  }

  return (
    <FormDialog
      title={t("ceph.clients.title")}
      description={t("ceph.clients.description")}
      submitLabel={t("ceph.clients.install")}
      submitDisabled={chosen.length === 0}
      returnFocus={returnFocus}
      onClose={onClose}
      onSubmit={submit}
    >
      {choices.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("ceph.clients.none")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {choices.map((n) => (
            <li key={n.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id={`ceph-client-${n.id}`}
                checked={!skipped.includes(n.id)}
                onCheckedChange={(v) =>
                  setSkipped((s) => (v === true ? s.filter((id) => id !== n.id) : [...s, n.id]))
                }
              />
              <Label htmlFor={`ceph-client-${n.id}`}>{n.name}</Label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </FormDialog>
  );
}
```

```ts
import {

import { CEPH, CEPH_STATUS, DISKS, NET_NODE, NODE, pool } from "@/test/fixtures";

it("maps the Ceph health to a tone", () => {
  expect(healthTone("HEALTH_OK")).toBe("ok");
  expect(healthTone("HEALTH_WARN")).toBe("warn");
  expect(healthTone("HEALTH_ERR")).toBe("err");
  expect(healthTone("")).toBe("unknown");
});

it("groups OSDs by host in name and id order", () => {
  const hosts = osdHosts(CEPH_STATUS);
  expect(hosts.map((h) => [h.host, h.osds.map((o) => o.id), h.up])).toEqual([
    ["node-a", [0, 1], 1],
    ["node-b", [2, 3], 2],
  ]);
  expect(osdHosts({ ...CEPH_STATUS, osds: [] })).toEqual([]);
});

it("summarises placement group states, most first", () => {
  expect(pgSummary(CEPH_STATUS.pgs)).toEqual([
    { state: "active+clean", count: 120, percent: (120 * 100) / 129, clean: true },
    { state: "active+undersized", count: 9, percent: (9 * 100) / 129, clean: false },
  ]);
  expect(pgSummary({ total: 0, states: [] })).toEqual([]);
});

it("defaults the pool size to min(3, hosts) and warns about 1 and 2", () => {
  expect([0, 1, 2, 3, 7].map(defaultSize)).toEqual([1, 1, 2, 3, 3]);
  expect(sizeWarning(1)).toBe("ceph.pool.sizeOne");
  expect(sizeWarning(2)).toBe("ceph.pool.sizeTwo");
  expect(sizeWarning(3)).toBeNull();
});

it("warns about an even number of monitors", () => {
  expect([1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(monWarning)).toEqual([
    null,
    "ceph.mon.even",
    null,
    "ceph.mon.even",
    null,
  ]);
});

it("says whether a disk can take an OSD", () => {
  expect(DISKS.map(diskChoice)).toEqual([
    { kind: "blocked", reason: "system disk (/ is on it)" },
    { kind: "available" },
    { kind: "wipe", reasons: ["gpt partition table", "ext4 filesystem"] },
  ]);
});

it("accepts the device path, its name or its by-id link to confirm a wipe", () => {
  const [, sdb] = DISKS;
  for (const ok of ["/dev/sdb", "sdb", " sdb ", "/dev/disk/by-id/wwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d4"]) {
    expect(confirmWipe(sdb!, ok)).toBe(true);
  }
  for (const bad of ["", "/dev/sdc", "sd", "dev/sdb", "wwn-0x5000c500a1b2c3d4"]) {
    expect(confirmWipe(sdb!, bad)).toBe(false);
  }
});

it("fills the public network from the interface holding the node's address", () => {
  // NET_NODE의 주소 10.0.0.1은 vmbr0의 10.0.0.1/24에 있다.
  expect(publicNetworkFor(NET_NODE)).toBe("10.0.0.0/24");
  expect(
    publicNetworkFor({ ...NET_NODE, spec: { ...NET_NODE.spec, address: "10.0.0.1:8443" } }),
  ).toBe("10.0.0.0/24");
  // 인터페이스가 없거나, 주소가 이름이거나 IPv6면 채우지 않는다(서버가 정한다).
  expect(publicNetworkFor(NODE)).toBe("");
  expect(
    publicNetworkFor({ ...NET_NODE, spec: { ...NET_NODE.spec, address: "node-a:8443" } }),
  ).toBe("");
  expect(
    publicNetworkFor({ ...NET_NODE, spec: { ...NET_NODE.spec, address: "[fd00::1]:8443" } }),
  ).toBe("");
  const wide = {
    ...NET_NODE,
    spec: { ...NET_NODE.spec, address: "172.16.5.9:8443" },
    status: {
      ...NET_NODE.status,
      interfaces: [{ name: "eth0", kind: "ethernet", state: "up", addresses: ["172.16.5.9/12"] }],
    },
  } as typeof NET_NODE;
  expect(publicNetworkFor(wide)).toBe("172.16.0.0/12");
});

it("lists the Ceph daemons of a node", () => {

  expect(cephRoles(CEPH, "n3")).toEqual(["mon"]);
  expect(cephRoles(CEPH, "n9")).toEqual([]);

});

it("knows the storage pools of the managed Ceph by their configuration", () => {

  });
  const outside = pool("ext", { backend: { kind: "rbd", pool: "rbd" } });
  expect(isManagedPool(managed, CEPH)).toBe(true);
  expect(isManagedPool(outside, CEPH)).toBe(false);
  expect(isManagedPool(managed, null)).toBe(false);

});

it("computes a usage percentage", () => {

  expect(percentOf(1, 3)).toBe(33.3);
  expect(percentOf(5, 0)).toBe(0);
  expect(percentOf(9, 4)).toBe(100);
});
```

`web/src/ceph/ceph.ts`를 만든다:

```ts
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { ApiError, api, call } from "@/api/client";
import type {
  CephReport,
  CephStatusView,
  CephView,
  NodeDisk,
  Node,
  OsdReport,
  PgReport,
  StoragePool,
} from "@/api/types";

/** `GET /ceph`의 캐시 키. Ceph 리소스는 watch로 나가지 않아(키가 있음) 이 화면들이 주기적으로 다시 읽는다. */
export const CEPH_KEY = ["ceph"] as const;
export const CEPH_STATUS_KEY = ["ceph", "status"] as const;
/** 상태를 다시 읽는 간격. 서버가 5초 캐시를 둔다. */
export const CEPH_REFRESH_MS = 10_000;
/** 서버의 `MAX_MONS` */
export const MAX_MONS = 5;

/** 부트스트랩 Task(`ceph-init`)의 진행 단계(서버의 진행률 stage 순서) */
export const INIT_STAGES = [
  "checking",
  "installing-packages",
  "writing-config",
  "creating-monitor",
  "starting-monitor",
  "waiting-for-quorum",
  "creating-manager",
] as const;

/** 관리 Ceph. 없으면(404) null이다. `poll`이면 Ceph 화면처럼 주기적으로 다시 읽는다. */
export function useCeph(poll = false) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: CEPH_KEY,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<CephView | null> => {
      try {
        return await call(api.GET("/ceph"));
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404) {
          return null;
        }
        throw err;
      }
    },
    refetchInterval: poll ? CEPH_REFRESH_MS : false,
  });
}

/** Ceph 상태(mon 노드에서 읽음). 503 `ceph_unreachable`을 곧바로 보이도록 다시 시도하지 않는다. */
export function useCephStatus(enabled: boolean) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: CEPH_STATUS_KEY,
    // openapi-fetch는 PG 상태의 짝(`[string, number]`)을 배열로 넓히므로 스키마 타입으로 되돌린다.
    queryFn: async () => (await call(api.GET("/ceph/status"))) as CephStatusView,
    refetchInterval: CEPH_REFRESH_MS,
    retry: false,
    enabled,
  });
}

/** health 배지의 모양 */
export type HealthTone = "ok" | "warn" | "err" | "unknown";

export function healthTone(status: string): HealthTone {
  switch (status) {
    case "HEALTH_OK":
      return "ok";
    case "HEALTH_WARN":
      return "warn";
    case "HEALTH_ERR":
      return "err";
    default:
      return "unknown";
  }
}

/** 호스트 하나의 OSD들 */
export interface OsdHost {
  host: string;
  osds: OsdReport[];
  up: number;
}

/** OSD를 호스트별로(호스트 이름 순, 그 안은 id 순) */
export function osdHosts(report: CephReport): OsdHost[] {
  const byHost = new Map<string, OsdReport[]>();
  for (const osd of report.osds) {
    byHost.set(osd.host, [...(byHost.get(osd.host) ?? []), osd]);
  }
  return [...byHost.entries()]
    .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([host, osds]) => ({
      host,
      osds: [...osds].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id),
      up: osds.filter((o) => o.up).length,
    }));
}

/** PG 상태 하나와 전체에서의 비율(%) */
export interface PgPart {
  state: string;
  count: number;
  percent: number;
  /** `active+clean`이면 참 */
  clean: boolean;
}

/** PG 상태 요약: 많은 상태부터. 전체가 0이면 빈 목록 */
export function pgSummary(pgs: PgReport): PgPart[] {
  if (pgs.total === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  return [...pgs.states]
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0]))
    .map(([state, count]) => ({
      state,
      count,
      percent: (count * 100) / pgs.total,
      clean: state === "active+clean",
    }));
}

/** 새 풀의 기본 복제 수: min(3, OSD가 up인 호스트 수). 호스트가 없으면 1(서버가 거절한다) */
export function defaultSize(hosts: number): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(3, hosts));
}

/** 복제 수의 경고(번역 키): 1은 사본 하나, 2는 하나가 꺼지면 잃을 수 있음 */
export function sizeWarning(size: number): string | null {
  return size === 1 ? "ceph.pool.sizeOne" : size === 2 ? "ceph.pool.sizeTwo" : null;
}

/** mon 수의 경고(번역 키): 짝수면 홀수(3·5)가 정족수를 가장 잘 지킨다. */
export function monWarning(count: number): string | null {
  return count > 0 && count % 2 === 0 ? "ceph.mon.even" : null;
}

/** 디스크를 OSD로 고를 수 있는지: 그대로, 지우고, 못 씀(이유) */
export type DiskChoice =
  { kind: "available" } | { kind: "wipe"; reasons: string[] } | { kind: "blocked"; reason: string };

export function diskChoice(disk: NodeDisk): DiskChoice {
  switch (disk.state) {
    case "available":
      return { kind: "available" };
    case "wipeable":
      return { kind: "wipe", reasons: disk.reasons };
    case "in-use":
      return { kind: "blocked", reason: disk.reason };
  }
}

/** 지우기 확인의 입력이 그 디스크인지(CLI처럼 `/dev/sdb`·`sdb`·by-id 경로) */
export function confirmWipe(disk: NodeDisk, input: string): boolean {
  const text = input.trim();
  return (
    text !== "" &&
    (text === disk.path || disk.path.replace(/^\/dev\//, "") === text || disk.by_id === text)
  );
}

/** IPv4 주소를 32비트 수로. 아니면 null */
function ipv4(text: string): number | null {
  const parts = text.split(".");
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts.some((p) => !/^\d{1,3}$/.test(p) || Number(p) > 255)) {
    return null;
  }
  return parts.reduce((n, p) => n * 256 + Number(p), 0);
}

/**
 * 서버의 `default_public_network`처럼: 노드 주소(`host:port`나 `host`)의 IP를 가진 인터페이스 주소의 망(CIDR).
 * 마법사가 미리 채우는 값이라 IPv4만 본다(그 밖에는 빈 문자열 — 비워 두면 서버가 같은 규칙으로 정한다).
 */
export function publicNetworkFor(node: Node): string {
  const parts = node.spec.address.split(":");
  const ip = ipv4(parts.length <= 2 ? (parts[0] ?? "") : "");
  if (ip === null) {
    return "";
  }
  for (const iface of node.status.interfaces ?? []) {
    for (const cidr of iface.addresses ?? []) {
      const [addr = "", prefixText = ""] = cidr.split("/");
      const prefix = Number(prefixText);
      if (ipv4(addr) !== ip || !/^\d+$/.test(prefixText) || prefix > 32) {
        continue;
      }
      const mask = prefix === 0 ? 0 : (0xffffffff << (32 - prefix)) >>> 0;
      const net = (ip & mask) >>> 0;
      return `${[24, 16, 8, 0].map((s) => (net >>> s) & 255).join(".")}/${prefix}`;
    }
  }
  return "";
}

/** Ceph 역할이 있는 노드인지와 그 역할들(`mon`·`mgr`·`osd`) */
export function cephRoles(ceph: CephView | null | undefined, node: string): string[] {
  if (!ceph) {
    return [];
  }
  return [
    ceph.mons.some((m) => m.node === node) && "mon",
    ceph.mgrs.includes(node) && "mgr",
    ceph.osd_nodes.includes(node) && "osd",
  ].filter((r): r is string => r !== false);
}

/** Orbivisor가 관리하는 Ceph의 RBD 풀인지(관리 클라이언트 conf를 쓰는 풀) */
export function isManagedPool(pool: StoragePool, ceph: CephView | null | undefined): boolean {
  const b = pool.spec.backend;
  return !!ceph && b.kind === "rbd" && b.conf === ceph.managed_conf;
}

/** 사용률(0~100, 소수 한 자리). 전체가 0이면 0 */
export function percentOf(used: number, total: number): number {
  return total > 0 ? Math.round((Math.min(used, total) * 1000) / total) / 10 : 0;
}
```

을 다음으로 바꾼다:

```tsx
  expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Settings" })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/settings");
  // 관리 Ceph도 누구나 읽는다(바꾸기는 admin만).
  expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Ceph" })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/ceph");
  // 원격 클러스터도 누구나 읽는다.
```

```tsx
import type { RefObject } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import type { Node } from "@/api/types";
import { DiskTable, useNodeDisks } from "@/ceph/AddOsdDialog";
import { focusBack } from "@/components/focusBack";
import { ListPending } from "@/components/ListPending";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

/** 노드의 디스크와 Ceph OSD로 쓸 수 있는지(`GET /nodes/{key}/disks`). 연 쪽은 열 때만 그린다. */
export function NodeDisksDialog({
  node,
  onClose,
  returnFocus,
}: {
  node: Node;
  onClose(): void;
  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const disks = useNodeDisks(node.id);
  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-3xl" onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => focusBack(e, returnFocus)}>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{t("nodes.disks.title", { name: node.name })}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{t("nodes.disks.description")}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
          {disks.data ? (
            <DiskTable disks={disks.data} label={t("ceph.disk.table")} />
          ) : (
            <ListPending error={disks.error} />
          )}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            {t("common.done")}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
it("shows what is left to do by hand after removing a node", async () => {
  cluster();
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, DOWN] });
  server.use(
    http.delete(apiUrl("/nodes/n2"), () =>
      HttpResponse.json({
        warnings: [
          'node "node-b" ran a Ceph monitor; remove it from the Ceph monitor map by hand with: ceph mon remove node-b',
        ],
      }),
    ),
  );
  renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-b" }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Remove from cluster" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog");
  await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Type node-b to confirm"), "node-b");
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove from cluster" }));
  expect(await screen.findByText(/ceph mon remove node-b/)).toBeInTheDocument();
});
```

```tsx
it("shows the Ceph daemons of each node and opens its disks", async () => {
  cluster();
  const witness = { ...NODE, id: "n5", name: "node-w", spec: { ...NODE.spec, witness: true } };
  mockLists({ node: [NODE, DOWN, witness] });
  server.use(
    http.get(apiUrl("/ceph"), () => HttpResponse.json(CEPH)),
    http.get(apiUrl("/nodes/n1/disks"), () => HttpResponse.json(DISKS)),
  );
  renderPage(<NodesPage />);
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  const table = await screen.findByRole("table", { name: "Nodes" });
  const column = within(table)
    .getAllByRole("columnheader")
    .findIndex((h) => h.textContent === "Ceph");
  const cell = (name: string) =>
    within(within(table).getByText(name).closest("tr")!).getAllByRole("cell")[column]!;
  await within(table).findByText("node-a");
  expect(await within(cell("node-a")).findByText("mon, mgr, osd")).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(cell("node-b")).toHaveTextContent("mgr, osd");
  expect(cell("node-w")).toHaveTextContent("—");
  // 위트니스에는 디스크 메뉴가 없다.
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-w" }));
  expect(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit labels" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  expect(screen.queryByRole("menuitem", { name: "Disks…" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  await user.keyboard("{Escape}");
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Actions for node-a" }));
  await user.click(await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Disks…" }));
  const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Disks of node-a" });
  const disks = await within(dialog).findByRole("table", { name: "Disks" });
  expect(within(disks).getByText("/dev/sdc").closest("tr")).toHaveTextContent(
    "Must be erasedgpt partition table, ext4 filesystem",
  );
  // 읽기만 하는 표라 고르는 단추가 없다.
  expect(within(disks).queryByRole("radio")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
});
```
